initiatives.name: Lifting Lowellians: Assistance and Mutual Aid (LLAMA)
initiatives.description: Volunteer mutual aid group in Lowell, MA, started in March 2020. Connects residents requesting and offering help, such as food and supply deliveries, through neighborhood pods.

initiatives.name: Lowell ABC
initiatives.description: Anarchist Black Cross chapter in Lowell and Lawrence, Massachusetts. Supports political prisoners and holds an annual Running Down the Walls 5K fundraiser.
